claim: The Kentucky at a glance page renders from the production build with six headline tiles, a 120-county map with drill-down, the plan comparison table, working pins, and no horizontal overflow on a phone.
assertions: Simple view left nav shows exactly the six simple tabs plus SME view.
Renders 8 headline tiles on At a glance.
Renders 0 map paths on At a glance.
Review build shows hand-entered tiles and no review banner.
Renders 120 county paths on the county tab.
County tab: clicking Jefferson County opens its breakdown.
Renders 6 plan rows on the plan tab.
Waiver, behavioral health and district tabs each open their own page.
SME view shows the original tabs headed by At a glance, which returns to the simple view.
Pinning a tile moves it first.
No horizontal overflow at a 390 px phone width.
